image_description: A minimalist interior staircase featuring a sleek, metallic handrail mounted directly onto a sage green wall. The railing is anchored by a single, prominent white newel post with a decorative, curled top situated on the landing. The stairs themselves are light-colored wood or laminate. There are no visible intermediate balusters between the newel post and the wall-mounted section.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Vertical railing system following staircase geometry creating diagonal linear pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrail clearly follows the diagonal incline of the stairs against the wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous handrail supported by evenly spaced balusters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a 'floating' or wall-mounted rail design. There are no slender vertical balusters supporting the handrail along its length; it is attached directly to the wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Balusters are slender cylindrical or turned posts of narrow diameter, closely spaced relative to their height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No balusters are visible in the main span of the railing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Handrail is smooth rounded or molded strip running parallel to staircase incline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrail is a smooth, cylindrical metal tube running parallel to the stairs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Newel posts thicker vertical supports anchor ends and corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, thick white newel post anchors the bottom/landing end of the railing system.
The geometric alignment of the rail matches the stair steps perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Materials range from polished wood with ornate turnings to sleek metal with minimal design.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrail appears to be brushed metal (sleek/minimal), while the newel post appears to be painted wood or composite.
Visual textures confirm metal for the rail and likely wood/composite for the post and stairs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Evenly spaced vertical posts creating rhythmic pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Due to the wall-mounted design, there is no rhythmic pattern of vertical posts/balusters.

artifact_observations.location: Connection point between handrail and wall/newel post
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mounting hardware for the handrail is invisible or poorly defined. The rail appears to float slightly off the wall without clear brackets, and its connection to the newel post lacks a visible mechanical joint, suggesting a slight AI generation oversight in structural logic.
The decorative curl on top of the newel post is somewhat amorphous and lacks sharp definition, looking slightly melted or soft compared to the crisp edges of the post body.
The lines of the stair treads are mostly straight but show very slight waviness, typical of AI-generated architectural lines.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a bannister/railing system despite the non-traditional (baluster-less) design.
To verify the physical separation and mounting logic of the rail against the wall, checking for floating artifacts.
To inspect the boundary of the newel post, specifically the decorative top, for melting or fusion issues.
To assess the overall realism of lighting and shadows, particularly where the rail casts shadow on the wall.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the handrail mounting (invisible brackets)
Definition and sharpness of the newel post decorative top
Linearity of stair edges and handrail
Consistency of shadows cast by the rail onto the green wall
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'missing balusters' checkpoint. While the taxonomy defines balusters as standard, modern 'floating' rails exist. Determine if the absence of balusters is a stylistic choice (valid) or a generation failure (incomplete structure). Also, scrutinize the connection points for physical plausibility.
